ZooTraits is a Shiny app to explore, compare, download and upload animal trait data for research in ecology and evolution. It brings together, in one place, trait data from the Open Traits Network, the AnimalTraits database and other compiled datasets, through three features: *ExploreTrait*, *FeedTrait* and *GetTrait*.

I was responsible for developing the Shiny app and organizing the data.
